summary.text: Shay Frisby is the Democratic candidate for Delaware State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Brent Burdge and Carolyn Frank of the Independent Party of Delaware in a race with no incumbent.
She defeated incumbent Raymond Seigfried in the Democratic primary on September 15, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Shay Frisby earned an associate degree from Delaware Technical Community College in 1997, a bachelor's degree from Wesley College in 2009 and a graduate degree from Wilmington University in 2015.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Frisby described herself as a mother, wife, grandmother, minister, community leader, entrepreneur and community advocate who has lived in Claymont for more than 30 years.
Frisby won the District 5 Democratic primary with 58.4% of the vote to Seigfried's 41.6% in unofficial totals.

In the survey, she said her campaign focuses on working-class issues and affordability, including affordable housing, renter protections and more assistance for unhoused people, and that she rejects donations from corporations and business PACs.
She said she has been active with the H.O.M.E.S. Campaign of Delaware.
